recap.text: Across the river, Carl finds the ursine dead, chomped in half by something huge, and pink boa feathers on the ground. He ties the sleeping Samantha to his back by her hair and loots armour, enchanted daggers and swords worth over a thousand gold. At the edges he disarms the remaining traps, including a new one called Slippery Slope, which would have dropped him into the water, and pockets them all.

beats.headline: Into the inventory
beats.text: Across the river on the south shore, the ursine are big dead, chomped in half by something huge, and pink boa feathers litter the ground. Carl ties the sleeping Samantha to his back by her hair and loots armour, enchanted daggers and swords, worth over a thousand gold in all. Most of the traps here have already been disarmed or triggered, but at the edges of the area he finds and disarms a few more, among them a new one called Slippery Slope, which would have caused him to slip and fall into the water. The traps all go into his inventory.
beats.gist: Carl disarms the new Slippery Slope trap, among others, and loots the dead ursine's gear.
